component.name: Total Markdown
component.summary: A fast, native, two-pane Markdown viewer and editor

description.p: Total Markdown opens a Markdown document in two panes: the source, syntax highlighted, on the left and the rendered preview on the right, both kept in step while you type. It is built on Qt Widgets only — no web engine — which keeps the startup instant and the rendering fully native.

Documents support CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks), fenced code blocks highlighted per language by KDE's KSyntaxHighlighting, LaTeX formulas typeset by the bundled MicroTeX engine, images resolved relative to the document, remote images downloaded in the background and cached on disk, and animated GIF and SVG badges. Themes come as light, dark, follow-system and any JSON file; a size policy keeps very large documents responsive.
Second alpha release: multi-platform builds for Windows (x64) and macOS (Apple Silicon), accelerated image caching and downscaling, table cell image constraint fixes, and UI/speed enhancements.
First public alpha: two-pane live preview, CommonMark and GFM, syntax-highlighted code fences, LaTeX math, light/dark/system themes, remote images with a disk cache, and animated badge playback.
